definitions.formal: Fixed original 52 regression/development questions, archived original Dense ranks and identical 129 indexed Points; deterministic expansion; no holdout or new quality dataset
definitions.budgets: At most original+2 variants, each extra <=2000 codepoints, total <=6000; 30/30/10 per query, <=210 reserved raw slots, merged channel caps 30/30/10, fusion<=60, rerank<=30, TopK5; Context5/16000
definitions.merge: Within each channel select best original query rank; ties prefer earlier query then UUID; assign merged ranks; one RRF vote per channel k60; repeat matches do not sum query votes
definitions.provenance: matched_queries contains only actual supporting queries; an expansion-only hit never claims the original matched it; original remains the request and rerank question
definitions.dense: Original ranks reused only for the exact archived original request; every nonempty new variant uses its own real qwen3-embedding:0.6b vector and real Qdrant search on a private exact clone
definitions.guards: Formal lexical corpus is the frozen Task5 image; private Qdrant clone checked before/after. Three independent live scopes use actual QdrantImageReader/FilteredDenseChannel guards
definitions.llm: Four predeclared separate probes, one optional Structured Output call each, qwen2.5:0.5b unchanged; max_tokens512, temperature0, SDK retries0, deadline15s; raw invalid output retained; no answer generation
definitions.latency: Formal wall time includes frozen-corpus checks, archived-original loading, real variant embedding/search and optional rerank; not a production service latency benchmark
definitions.defaults: Expansion and Rerank remain off in product/API; Task14 freezes and evaluates final defaults on holdout
